newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Kenilworth, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Kenilworth, N.J..

text.p: Sealed Proposals will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Borough of Kenilworth at the Kenilworth Municipal Offices, 567 Boulevard, Kenilworth, New Jersey 07033 on
until 11:00 o'clock a.m. for the purchase of the above
Bonds of the Borough dated February 1, 1997 and due (subject to prior redemption) on February 1 as follows:

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one bond for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Borough in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Wolff & Samson, P.A., Roseland, New Jersey.

The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on February 1 and August 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on August 1, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.

The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and the Proposal for Bonds are available by contacting Dianne C. Kurutza, Chief Financial Officer at 567 Boulevard, Kenilworth, New Jersey 07033 (telephone (908) 276-6272).
*Subject to change in accordance with the Notice of Sale.
